Overview

Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do.

 

At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits.

 

Software & AI Labs is seeking a Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join the Models & Data Science program. The program develops the core AI/ML models behind Keysight’s design, simulation, calibration, and measurement solutions.

 

The Reinforcement Learning Engineer will develop RL agents and optimization methods for automated measurement sequencing, closed-loop RF tuning, and adaptive calibration. This early-career role is suited to a recent graduate with a strong foundation in reinforcement learning and software engineering who wants to apply RL to real RF and measurement problems. The successful candidate will work alongside senior ML engineers and RF measurement experts, learn Keysight’s calibration and characterization workflows, and grow into ownership of RL components that ship in Keysight products.

Responsibilities

Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, or a related field.
0-2 years of industry experience. Graduate research, internships, and thesis work in reinforcement learning count toward the requirement.
Solid understanding of reinforcement learning fundamentals, including policy gradient, actor-critic, and value-based methods.
Hands-on experience implementing or training RL algorithms such as PPO, SAC, or DDPG.
Proficiency in Python and PyTorch.
Experience with RL tooling such as Gymnasium, Stable-Baselines3, RLlib, or equivalent.
Strong foundation in linear algebra, probability, and optimization.
Good software engineering habits, including version control, testing, and readable code.
Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to work well in a team.

Qualifications

Coursework or experience in RF, microwave engineering, electromagnetics, or signal processing.
Familiarity with S-parameters, VNA measurements, calibration methods (SOLT, TRL), or de-embedding.
Experience with Bayesian optimization or Gaussian process methods.
Experience applying RL to control, robotics, hardware-in-the-loop, or design optimization problems.
Working knowledge of C++ or CUDA.
Experience with instrument control (SCPI, IVI, VISA) or scikit-rf.
Experience with generative models (VAEs, GANs, Diffusion) for data augmentation.
Publications, open-source contributions, or competition results in reinforcement learning.

 

 

Careers Privacy Statement

Keysight Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

 

The level of role will be based on applicable experience, education and skills; Most offers will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the Salary Range listed below.

 

California pay range: MIN $113,000- MAX $188,330

 

Note: For other locations, pay ranges will vary by region
